2607.08646.title: UltraX: Refining Pre-Training Data at Scale with Adaptive Programmatic Editing
2607.08646.paper_summary: As available training data approaches its physical limit, gains from Scaling Laws have begun to diminish. Consequently, improving Large Language Models (LLMs) now depends less on data expansion and more on higher-quality data utilization. However, in the context of large-scale corpora, existing refinement methodologies face significant limitations in quality, efficiency, and reliability: Rule-based approaches are constrained by fixed heuristics and struggle with instance-level variations; LLM-based approaches improve quality but fail to meet the efficiency and reliability requirements of large-scale data processing. To address these challenges, we propose UltraX, a function-calling refinement framework for large-scale pre-training data that completes the editing function space by introducing insertion in addition to deletion and modification, enabling fine-grained instance-level editing. Specifically, UltraX builds a reliable program-supervision generation pipeline. In this pipeline, dataset-adaptive prompt optimization first guides an expert LLM to produce high-quality end-to-end refined texts, and Line Alignment Mapping and Dynamic Context Replacement then convert original-refined text pairs into structured program supervision. Meanwhile, UltraX improves supervision quality and stabilizes the training distribution with low-confidence example filtering and ratio-controlled sampling by operation combination. During inference and execution, it normalizes and validates model outputs through sliding-window prediction, global operation aggregation, and systematic post-processing, improving the stability and reliability of large-scale execution. Experiments show that UltraX achieves the highest average performance across all corpora and also matches or surpasses baselines with fewer training tokens, demonstrating stronger data efficiency and refinement reliability.
2607.08646.paper_summary_zh: 隨著可用訓練數據接近其物理極限，擴展法則帶來的增益已開始減少。<lb/>因此，改善大型語言模型（LLMs）現在不再主要依賴數據擴展，而是更依賴於高品質數據的利用。<lb/>然而，在大規模語料庫的背景下，現有的精煉方法在質量、效率和可靠性方面面臨重大限制：基於規則的方法受到固定啟發式的限制，並且在實例級變化上掙扎；基於LLM的方法提高了質量，但未能滿足大規模數據處理的效率和可靠性要求。<lb/>為了解決這些挑戰，我們提出了UltraX，一個針對大規模預訓練數據的函數調用精煉框架，通過引入插入功能來補充刪除和修改，完成編輯功能空間，實現細粒度的實例級編輯。<lb/>具體而言，UltraX構建了一個可靠的程序監督生成管道。在這個管道中，數據集自適應提示優化首先引導專家LLM生成高質量的端到端精煉文本，然後行對齊映射和動態上下文替換將原始-精煉文本對轉換為結構化的程序監督。<lb/>同時，UltraX通過低置信度示例過濾和基於操作組合的比例控制抽樣來提高監督質量並穩定訓練分佈。<lb/>在推理和執行過程中，它通過滑動窗口預測、全局操作聚合和系統後處理來標準化和驗證模型輸出，提高大規模執行的穩定性和可靠性。<lb/>實驗表明，UltraX在所有語料庫中實現了最高的平均性能，並且在使用更少的訓練標記的情況下也能匹配或超越基準，顯示出更強的數據效率和精煉可靠性。
